description: Defines data structures, enums, and classes for handling 'capsules' in the quiche library, including capsule types, capsule data structures, and parsing/serialization logic.

classes.name: Capsule
classes.description: Represents a generic capsule that can hold various capsule types, with methods for creation, comparison, and string representation.

classes.name: CapsuleParser
classes.description: Parses capsule fragments from a data stream and notifies a visitor upon successful parsing or failure.

methods.name: Capsule::Datagram
methods.description: Creates a capsule containing a datagram payload.

methods.name: Capsule::LegacyDatagram
methods.description: Creates a capsule with legacy datagram payload.

methods.name: Capsule::LegacyDatagramWithoutContext
methods.description: Creates a legacy datagram capsule without context.

methods.name: Capsule::CloseWebTransportSession
methods.description: Creates a capsule to close a WebTransport session with an error code and message.

methods.name: Capsule::Unknown
methods.description: Creates a capsule with an unknown type and payload.
